info.name: JobSense API
info.description: JobSense REST API. `baseUrl` defaults to http://localhost:5000/api (use your Render URL + /api in production). Run **Auth > Register** or **Login** first - the bearer token is stored in the `token` collection variable automatically. **Admin > Admin login** stores `adminToken`. Seeded admin: admin@jobsense.local / Admin@12345 (change it after setup).
